purpose: Document first-party local cadastral/map evidence and bounded anonymous geometry access review.
assessment: Both official ArcGIS REST services were reachable anonymously. Service metadata exposed parcel-layer schema and CRS. A bounded exact-WUP-point query against the City of Riverside Parcel layer and the Riverside County Assessor PARCELS layer returned polygon geometry with safe native object identity; one City polygon is retained.
registryAssessment: Local registry/map custody is evidenced by the City of Riverside cadastral public viewer service. Countywide assessor parcel custody is separately evidenced by Riverside County GIS/Assessor OpenData. This is source qualification only, not runtime adapter admission.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Public Cadastral_Public MapServer describes the City of Riverside public viewer, lists Parcel layer 86, uses Web Mercator, and supports Query/JSON/geoJSON.
Parcel layer metadata exposes native ParcelFabric_Parcels.OBJECTID and APN fields plus polygon geometry; only OBJECTID was requested.

Official layer describes taxable parcel polygons within Riverside County, replicated from the Assessor CountyGIS geodatabase; native OBJECTID and APN fields are documented, but only OBJECTID was requested.

fieldMapping.retainedSample: The retained GeoJSON id 44648 is the City service's native ParcelFabric_Parcels.OBJECTID. No synthetic row number or composite key was used.

attempts.result: Service metadata retrieved anonymously; public Cadastral_Public service and Web Mercator CRS confirmed.
Parcel layer schema retrieved anonymously; native OBJECTID and polygon geometry confirmed.

attempts.parameters: Point -117.443821994716,33.9351928344791 in EPSG:4326; intersects; geoJSON; geometry true; outFields restricted to ParcelFabric_Parcels.OBJECTID; no resultRecordCount
attempts.result: One polygon returned with native OBJECTID 44648. A prior bounded request including resultRecordCount=3 returned service error 400 Pagination is not supported; retry without pagination succeeded.
County Assessor parcel layer metadata retrieved anonymously; taxable parcel polygon scope and CRS confirmed.

attempts.parameters: Point -117.443821994716,33.9351928344791 in EPSG:4326; intersects; geoJSON; geometry true; outFields restricted to OBJECTID; resultRecordCount=3
attempts.result: One polygon returned with native OBJECTID 816856. It was used as corroborating evidence but not retained.

geometryDecision.exactWupPointTest: Exact WUP point intersected one City polygon and one County polygon; this does not establish citywide coverage.
requestEvidence: City and County successful GET query responses are preserved unchanged under tmp/valhalla-parcel-research/riverside/.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: City service is city-scoped; County Assessor service is county-scoped.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Public anonymous metadata and exact-point response verified; broad extent and completeness not tested.

remainingUncertainty: No citywide sampling, completeness audit, temporal currency audit, or independent parcel-boundary validation was performed. The City service's APN and owner-related schema fields were deliberately excluded. No login, credentials, private tokens, CAPTCHA bypass, or unsafe fields were used.
